key_insight: MAS-Guard unifies local agent safeguards and system-level controls to protect single- and multi-agent LLM workflows.
engineering_relevance: Developers can combine event-level checks with interaction controls to guard systems containing both instrumentable and opaque agents.
method: Local A-Guard uses task-specific experts to assess events within instrumentable agents.
Developer-owned Agent Charters and a Control Plane check routes, capabilities, message formats, roles, and content.
Shared interventions allow execution, trigger reflection, request confirmation, or block.
evidence_signal: Across six benchmarks and three agent LLMs from different providers, MAS-Guard reduced overall attack success rates by 71.5–86.3% relative to unguarded agents while meeting the benign-task utility reference criterion.
watch_item: Opaque agents limit internal visibility; deployment latency and operational overhead are not quantified in the abstract.
paper_title: MAS-Guard: Unified Guardrails from Individual Agents to Multi-Agent LLM Systems
